0.name: Project Setup
notes: Scaffolded via `npm create vite@latest . -- --template react` into a temp subfolder then moved up (create-vite's non-empty-dir prompt can't run non-interactively).

Vite 8 uses the rolldown bundler; rollupOptions.manualChunks must be a function not an object, or it fails the build. Removed manualChunks entirely -- dynamic import() alone is enough to code-split Modules 5/6's heavy libs, no bundler config needed.
Placeholder PNG icons (192/512, solid teal #0f9d8a) generated via a throwaway Node script (no PIL/ImageMagick available) -- swap for real branded icons before shipping.
src/App.jsx replaced Vite's default template with a minimal Supabase status check using supabase.auth.getSession() (works with no tables yet -- categories/inventory_items don't exist until Module 1).
package.json name fixed from 'scaffold-tmp' (leftover temp folder name) to 'expiry-tracker'.
`npm run build` succeeds: service worker + manifest.webmanifest generated correctly.
Supabase project created (ref rrrgwvndhubaxoxeklex); anon key verified live via /auth/v1/health -> HTTP 200.

Deploy switched from Vercel-CLI plan to GitHub-connected auto-deploy: created github.com/mechahuman/Expiry-Tracker, renamed local branch master->main, pushed, connected via Vercel dashboard import with VITE_SUPABASE_URL/VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY env vars set there.

1.name: DB Schema (Categories, Inventory, Badges, RLS)
notes: I do not have Postgres/DB credentials (only VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, not the DB password or a Management API token), so schema DDL can't be run by me directly -- user must paste supabase/schema.sql into the Supabase SQL Editor and run it.

supabase/schema.sql: idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS / ON CONFLICT / DROP POLICY IF EXISTS) so safe to re-run. Creates profiles, categories (seeded), inventory_items, badges, user_badges. Enables RLS + auth.uid()-based policies on profiles/inventory_items/user_badges only -- categories/badges are shared reference data, intentionally left without RLS.
user_badges has no update/delete policy by design -- earned badges are append-only for the client; default-deny (no policy = no access) covers this, not an oversight.

supabase/test_rls.sql: step-by-step manual RLS verification script (create 2 test auth users, seed one inventory row each, impersonate each via request.jwt.claims + `set local role authenticated`, confirm isolation).
